10: How does a bulkhead barb connect tubing across a panel?
11: The PMB body has a continuous passage. As tubing is pushed on axially, its wall expands over the barb and contacts the surface to provide sealing and retention. The central shoulder and nut clamp the panel. Tubing sealing, panel retention and the internal passage perform different functions; diagnose each at its own location.

47: How do tubing ID, barb OD and internal bore differ?

49: Compatible tube inside diameter: 2.4 mm. This is the tube opening before assembly; use it to select the tube size.

146: Will tightening the panel nut stop a leak at the tubing end?
147: The PMBSN nut clamps the panel; tubing seals by contacting the barb. Stop and depressurize, then check tube dimensions, insertion, end damage and material changes. Retest after repair. More panel-nut torque cannot correct a poor tube-to-barb fit.
